Technical Product Leader | Building AI Systems That Ship

paragraphs: I build AI-powered platforms that turn complex, manual workflows into automated systems. Over the past 10+ years across product, architecture, and engineering, I’ve shipped systems at scale. That includes consumer apps serving 500,000+ daily users and AI estimation platforms that process construction blueprints 32x faster with 99% accuracy validated against independent domain experts. What drives me is the gap between what AI can do and what most organizations actually ship. I work in that gap, turning LLM capabilities into production systems with real accuracy, real governance, and real business impact. That means owning decisions end-to-end, from data pipelines and model evaluation to workflow design and domain expert trust. Outside of work, I’m usually with my family or building something new just to see how far I can push it. If you’re building serious AI products and need someone who can operate across product and architecture, I’m always open to connecting.
